human_oversight.description: All trade orders above $500,000 require a two-person sign-off from the Risk Desk before execution.
An automated circuit-breaker halts all agent activity if drawdown exceeds 3% of portfolio value in a single session.
Daily summary report reviewed by the Chief Risk Officer every morning at 08:00 EST.
Any trade in a security flagged for regulatory review is blocked and escalated to Compliance.

incident_contact.name: Quantitative Risk Team
incident_contact.escalation_path: PagerDuty 'fintech-ai-critical', then on-call Risk Officer, then CTO
